verdict.rationale: Anthropic's docs claim Skills are automatically loaded 'when relevant' without explicit invocation (docs-2, docs-3, docs-25), which is the closest analog to rule-based automatic triggering on events. However, extensive hands-on community reports concretely contradict reliable automatic triggering — users report skills are 'hit or miss', agents 'just don't use them without being asked', and some had to bypass the mechanism entirely by pasting skill content into AGENTS.md to get consistent behavior (comm-6 through comm-14). Missing for 10: reliable event-based (not just semantic-relevance) triggering, first-party acknowledgment of the triggering reliability issue, and independent benchmark data showing consistent auto-invocation.
